text: What seat count did Gideon land on for Vantorre Group in the July thread in #strategic-pod? He corrected himself in that thread and I want the corrected figure for the QBR deck.
reply_text:
Gideon corrected the figure to 280 seats for Vantorre Group in the July 1 #strategic-pod thread (ts 1782915540), replacing his earlier 300. He said 280 is the production roster count as of Jul 1, excluding sandbox logins from the May rollout.

Note that this is the figure as of July 1. If the QBR deck needs a more recent count, check with Gideon.
